---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ""
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. E.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include:

- **What** the feature does (user-visible behavior).
- **Where** it lives (which tab, panel, API route, or pipeline stage).
- **Why** it matters (what it unblocks or improves).

## Alternatives considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered. Why did you reject them?

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here. Link to related issues, discussions, or external references.

## Scope check (for maintainers)

Help us triage by checking any that apply:

- [ ] Adds a new **council role** (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` → "How to add a new council role")
- [ ] Adds a new **provider** (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` → "How to add a new provider")
- [ ] Adds a new **document type** (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` → "How to add a new document type")
- [ ] Adds a new **pipeline stage** (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` → "How to add a new pipeline stage")
- [ ] Adds a new **domain pack** (see `src/lib/domain-packs.ts`)
- [ ] UI / UX improvement
- [ ] Performance / observability
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: ____________

## Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I'm willing to open a PR for this feature.
- [ ] I'd like to pair with a maintainer on it.
- [ ] I'm just suggesting — someone else can build it.
